title: Phase D review 2 — the find bar, revised

steps.headline: Your note, applied: the find bar is still a bordered pill, in a lane of its own, so it never covers the first message.
steps.changed: The full-width strip from round 1 is gone. The pill keeps its border, shadow and panel colour; the lane around it paints nothing and only reserves the height while the bar is open.
steps.measured: 0 px of the first message covered; the pill is the same 292 × 41 px as before
steps.notice: Ctrl+F: the pill appears top-right as it always did, and the messages nudge down under it instead of being covered. Esc: they slide back.
steps.risk: The nudge on open/close remains — that is the price of not overlapping.
